The key concept

Order → guide → verify.

Three surfaces that turn a manual hand-out into a proven pick.

1Product List
Every SKU with its bin, stock level and the barcode pasted on the shelf. The single source of truth for what can be issued.
Catalog + shelf barcodes
2Create Order
An engineer raises a pick request in seconds — select components, set quantities, priority and requester. It becomes a guided pick list.
Request to pick list
3Guided Picking
The picker follows a step-by-step interface on a handheld. The shelf lights up and the e-ink display shows the SKU and quantity — no item counts as taken until its barcode is scanned.
Enforced, validated picking
Staff picking workflow

Eight guided steps. Zero guesswork.

From badge login to manager alert — the handheld walks the picker through every line.

Take handheld & login → Confirm list → Go to rack → Take item → Scan barcode → Repeat → Complete
Hardware package

What you need to run it.

Three ingredients — an e-ink shelf display, a handheld, and your existing shelves.

E-ink shelf display

Fully wireless and battery-operated — no wires to run to the shelf. It states the SKU number and the quantity to pick, updated for every order.

Handheld terminal

NFC badge login and barcode scanner — the picker scans the shelf barcode to confirm the pick.

Your existing shelves

Guidance works at shelf level — no module at every SKU. The whole shelf lights up to guide the picker.

Not a light at every SKU — shelf-level guidance plus a wireless, battery-operated e-ink display that states exactly what to take.
Outcomes

What changes on day one.

Fewer errors, full traceability, and a store that runs itself.
